candidateEvidence: the reduced host sent the accepted zero-feature EarlyConfig and InitialConfig messages
the Hyper-V storage adapter started successfully
HCS attempted to add C:\WSL\Toybox-Minimal\ext4.vhdx as SCSI attachment 0
StorVspDeviceMountAndAssociateAdapter failed with an invalid HANDLE
HcsModifyComputeSystem returned 0x80010105 before any guest ext4 mount
candidateFatalEvidence: No GuestLog records were emitted. The custom kernel completed guest-capability and initial-configuration exchange, but the host could not dynamically associate the registered distro VHDX with the running Hyper-V storage adapter. The fixed shutdown process timed out and the controller subsequently forced termination before recovery.
recoveryEvidence: the registered Toybox ext4 filesystem mounted read-write
the fixed Toybox process printed toybox-ok and exited zero

classification.basis: The candidate booted the recorded external kernel and exchanged mini-init capabilities plus early and initial configuration over the host channel. Dynamic registered-distro storage attachment failed in HCS before ext4 mounted, so B3 and later gates are not supported. Independent stock recovery repeated B6-T.
